name: spacebook.resources.search
description: Search rooms and equipment with anonymous busy intervals. Filters apply to individual resources, not bundles: video=true requires built-in video on rooms and does not find room-plus-camera combinations. Omit filters to inspect all rooms and compatible portable equipment. Unknown facilities never match a requirement. Search does not reserve resources.

min_capacity.description: Room capacity filter. Equipment has no capacity and is excluded when this filter is supplied.

step_free.description: Filter the resource's known step-free access. Equipment has no accessibility value.

video.description: For rooms this means BUILT-IN video only, not video supplied by portable equipment. To find a room plus camera combination, omit this filter for rooms and inspect equipment compatibility separately.
